FN-7PJLE2V-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 71
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Steve Clouse
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/16/2024
House Bill 71 as introduced could increase the obligations of local governments by an
undetermined amount dependent on the compensation of certain full-time emergency medical
services technicians and paramedics allowed to purchase hazardous duty time for prior eligible
service in the Employee's Retirement System (ERS) of Alabama, pursuant to this bill, and the
respective employer contribution rates.
